PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Rainbow Six style leaning on foot: hold Q or E to lean round corners and shoot
PluginData.Description:
Rainbow Six style leaning for on-foot PvP. Hold Q or E.
- A real side-step: the server and other players see you lean out. Hitbox and gun move with you, shots go where you aim. - Camera and gun tilt with the lean. The aim point stays put. - Stops at walls. Let go and you step back to where you started. - Walk sideways while holding the lean to keep it. Letting go always straightens you up. - Works standing, crouching, through jumps and on moving ships.
Works offline, hosted and on dedicated servers. Client-side only: it just presses strafe for you. Off in jetpack, on ladders, in seats and on remote controls, turrets and cameras.
Keys: Q and E (vanilla roll, unused on foot). Rebindable, with Ctrl, Alt or Shift. Settings: hold or toggle, lean distance 0.2 to 0.8 m, camera tilt 0 to 20 degrees.
Works with Polar's ADS Improvements and head tracking. Known issues: third person gets the side-step but no tilt.
Docs and bug reports: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsADSLean
